description: This file defines the permissions service for the Focalboard application, including permission checks for users on boards, teams, and channels, and manages permission logic based on user roles and board membership.

classes.name: APIInterface
classes.description: Interface defining permission check methods for users.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Struct implementing permission checks, including board, team, and channel permissions.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Service instance with dependencies.

methods.name: HasPermissionTo
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific permission.

methods.name: HasPermissionToTeam
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific permission within a team.

methods.name: HasPermissionToChannel
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific permission within a channel.

methods.name: HasPermissionToBoard
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific permission on a board, considering roles, membership, and board visibility.
